decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - 1	The proposed development, by reason of its size, position and appearance would detract from the character of the streetscene, result in undue obtrusiveness and would fail to either preserve or enhance the character of the conservation area, contrary to Policies Env-B.1.1, Env-B.2.2 and H.6.3 of the Council's adopted 2003 UDP. 
2	The proposed development represents an unacceptable form of infill development, being out of character with the area and an overdevelopment of this site, resulting in inadequate parking and amenity space arrangements, and creating an oppressive sense of enclosure for neighbouring residential occupiers contrary to Policies H.6.3 and H.4.1 of the Council's Adopted 2003 UDP.
3	The redevelopment of this site for residential purposes, because of the limited distance between habitable room windows, the elevated carriageways of the M4 Motorway, and high degree of noise pollution; is considered inappropriate and would give rise to unsatisfactory living conditions for occupiers and also be contrary to UDP Policies H.4.1, H.6.3 and Env-B1.1.
description: Demolition of existing building and erection of a 3 storey building comprising B1 (Workspace) at ground floor and 4 x one bed flats at 1st and 2nd floors.
